key_insight: In an emergency medicine simulation benchmark, eight LLMs outperformed nine emergency physicians across several assessed clinical and communication domains.
clinical_relevance: The findings support further evaluation of AI for emergency medicine support, but do not establish safety or effectiveness in real patient care.
method: Emergency medicine experts assessed simulated visits for history taking, diagnosis, treatment planning, and empathy.
Interns playing patients rated performance from the patient perspective.
A written examination tested general emergency medicine knowledge.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports significant AI advantages in several domains, with differences among LLMs more pronounced on the written examination than during simulated visits.
watch_item: Simulation results from eight models and nine physicians may not generalize to real emergency departments; the abstract provides no effect sizes or patient outcomes.
paper_title: Benchmarking Large Language AI Models Against Human Doctors Using an Emergency Medicine Simulation Approach
